CustomField.description: Handwerksrolle registration. Elektrotechniker is Anlage A Nr. 25 (Meisterpflicht), and deletion from the Handwerksrolle cascades into deletion from the Installateurverzeichnis (Grundsätze §2.3.1). Left optional because §7(2), §7b and §§3/5 HwO give genuine routes in without a Meisterbrief.
